title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - LightPoint
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/LightPoint. An spatial point from where a light is projected. It might belong to a lamppost. Top-level saref:FeatureKind in the Lighting Domain (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.1.3).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'LightPoint'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geolocation of the light point, expressed as a GeoJSON Point.

lightProjectionHeight.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/LightProjectionHeight'. The height from which a light is projected. Unit of measure: metre (m); not fixed by the ontology. Flattened from saref:hasProperty :LightProjectionHeight (broader property: Height).

lightProjectionDirection.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/LightProjectionDirection'. The direction in which a light is projected. Represented as a compass bearing in degrees [0, 360); not fixed by the ontology. Flattened from saref:hasProperty :LightProjectionDirection.

projectsLight.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/projectsLight'. A relation between a lamppost or a light point and the light (or lights) they might project. Links to Light entities.
